verdict.rationale: Modal docs describe sandboxes as spin-up-in-seconds, pay-by-the-second environments with snapshot/checkpoint and filesystem persistence features that could support long-running agent workflows, but nowhere do the docs state an explicit max/typical session duration or confirm sandboxes can stay alive for hours or days; the framing as 'ephemeral environments' cuts against long-lived sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable long timeouts, hands-on reports of multi-hour/day sandbox uptime, and confirmation that snapshot/resume is used for long-duration agent tasks rather than just crash recovery.
